findings.note: The spec requires proving the reviewer did not rely on author notes/verdict, but defines no observable evidence for this. Different identity and invocation do not show what review material was provided. Define a verifiable review-input boundary and acceptance evidence (without asserting unverifiable internal reasoning); otherwise A-07 and the fail-closed condition are not independently testable.

findings.section: User Story 1; FR-002?FR-003; Edge Cases ? selected reviewer
findings.note: The reviewer is described as selected, but the spec does not say who selects it or from what applicable set. State the in-scope selection source/owner and observable behavior when no valid selection is supplied, so both success and failure can be tested without adding adaptive routing.

findings.section: FR-006; Success Criteria SC-004 (A-12) ? accessible status
findings.note: ?Understandable? and ?usable? do not define a reproducible pass condition for keyboard or screen-reader use. Define technology-agnostic checks for whether each listed state and its relevant information are perceivable and operable without color, with an explicit pass/fail outcome. As written, SC-004 is not reproducibly measurable.

The checklist marks requirements testable, success criteria measurable, and all criteria passed, but FR-003/SC-006 lack observable evidence for the independence boundary and SC-004 lacks a reproducible accessibility pass condition. Reassess these items and update the pass claims after addressing the spec gaps.
